title: I was about to sign up for Apex Trader Funding to run automated scripts, but then I actually read their Terms of Service… WTF is this?
author: Plus_Original_3154
selftext:
I was seriously considering buying an Apex account after seeing so many people praise them and talk about connecting webhooks/bots to pass evaluations on autopilot.

Before checking out, I decided to actually read their User Agreement and Terms of Use. There is zero chance I'm touching this platform now. The clauses in there are wild, this is straight up a scam :  


\-----  


**Full ban on automated trading, bots, webhooks, and algorithmic scripts (Manual clicks only):** « The use of any method, tool, script, macro, or system that pre-programs, batch-submits, pre-loads, auto-executes, modifies, or otherwise automates orders entry or order modification, whether in whole or in part, is strictly prohibited. »   
  
**Payouts are 100% discretionary and can be denied without giving a reason:**   
« Rewards are discretionary and do not represent a legal asset, entitlement, or obligation of the Company. \[...\] Any Rewards paid to you are entirely discretionary and may be withheld, forfeited, or rescinded at any time in the Company’s sole discretion. The Company reserves the right to deny, modify, reduce, cap, delay, or revoke Reward distributions for any reason or no reason... »   
  
**Account termination if your trading looks too profitable or "professional":**  
« The Company reserves the right to terminate any Trading Account(s) if it determines, in its sole discretion, that the User’s trading activity, strategies, or demonstrated level of sophistication materially exceeds the level contemplated by the simulated trading environment... »   
  
**Apex owns your strategy and can copy-trade your logic without paying you anything:**  
« You have no right, title, or interest in any trading positions, accounts, profits, or losses of the Company, regardless of whether the Company elects to copy, replicate, or otherwise use your simulated trading activity in its own accounts. No Profit Sharing – You are not entitled to receive, and the Company shall have no obligation to provide, any compensation, revenue sharing, or other payment based on the Company’s use of your trading activity in the live markets. »   
  
**Mandatory monthly activity quota on funded accounts (at least two days with $50+ profit per 30-day cycle):**  
« ...a Performance Account shall be deemed dormant if there are not a min of two trading days, per rolling 30 cycle with a minimum of at least $50 profit per day. So, every 30 days, two trading days of at least $50 profit each day, to keep the PA Account active ongoing. The Company may, in its sole discretion, deactivate or permanently terminate dormant Performance Accounts without further notice... »   
  
**Surveillance including keystroke tracking:**  
« You further agree that the Company may record any communication with you, including emails, phone calls, instant messages, texts, keystrokes, and other interactions on the platform. »  
  
**Mandatory video audit on demand with screen recording and 48-hour deadline:**  
« In connection with any verification or audit, the Company may require you to provide: written explanations, screenshots, notarized documentation, government-issued ID \[...\] a live trading session with a Company representative, video recordings of your trading sessions with commentary... You must respond to any request from the Company within 48 hours...   
  
**Strict non-disparagement and confidentiality clause (banning public posts about denials or closures):**  
« You agree not to make, publish, or disseminate any false, misleading, or defamatory statements, whether oral, written, or online, that could reasonably be expected to harm the reputation, business interests, or goodwill of the Company \[...\] "Confidential Information" means any non-public information related to the Company, including but not limited to: \[...\] Account closures, denial of Reward distributions... »   
  
**Dispute fees, mandatory Texas arbitration, and class-action waiver:**  
« YOU EXPRESSLY WAIVE THE RIGHT TO PARTICIPATE IN OR INITIATE ANY CLASS ACTION, COLLECTIVE ACTION, OR GROUP ARBITRATION OF ANY KIND. \[...\] Any dispute \[...\] must be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association (AAA) \[...\] in Travis County, Texas... »

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
that clause is in most of the futures eval firms now, Apex just spells it out. the funded account is a sim and the business is the eval fees, so a bot passing on autopilot is exactly what they don't want to pay out on.

if the point is running a script, a small cash account at a broker with an API is the honest route, nobody voids a payout over a webhook there. for testing before that, Quantradin is something I built, it only trades paper money and costs nothing, so a script can run there for weeks first. it's on my profile.

replies.author: Plus_Original_3154
replies.body:
Bro have you read what is in there? 

You don't own anything you produce, they can ban your account and steal your gains when they wish and you can't sue them nor make any negative allegation against them.

This is not normal.. we call it thieverue in France and all of these conditions are illegal in EU for a reason.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: yeah the screen recording clause alone would put me off. you're paying them and still getting treated like a suspect.
